name: Hybrid Ambient Occlusion (HAO) Sampling
aliases: Monte-Carlo integration over hemisphere with noise jitter
definition: The AO map is generated by Monte-Carlo integration over the hemisphere of each pixel to evaluate the ambient occlusion value.
summary: Hybrid Ambient Occlusion is a screen-space technique that prevents flickering by jittering ray directions with 3D noise and optimizes performance using fixed-step grid occupancy tests.
